notes.title: OVERPASS 2 is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577668/7de47f9c93e184f78192031b91c2233c58db576d.png[/img]

Howdy there! Today's a mighty big day, I tell ya! Overpass 2 done hit the scene! But before we go any further, in case y'all missed it, take a gander at that there reveal trailer down yonder:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=enk1EX5J40g


Well, shucks! Overpass 2, now that's the ultimate off-road extravaganza, I'm tellin' ya! It takes them good ol' bits from the first one that rolled out in 2020, but it don't stop there, no siree! They done gone and improved it, addin' a heap of new stuff. We're talkin':

- New drivin' physics
- Snazzy graphics
- New game modes
- And a whole mess of new maps to boot! 

And get this, it's all runnin' on that fancy-pants Unreal Engine 5. Ain't that somethin'? Y'all better hold onto yer hats 'cause it's gonna be a wild ride!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577668/a050b9358df0e86cfa1f8c56e0d1730e627eacd8.png[/img]

Get Overpass 2 in either the normal or deluxe edition, and become the ultimate off-road rider, whether you're playing solo or with friends in multiplayer!

See ya!
